PlayMakers Repertory Company has a second stage series, PRC², that examines controversial social and political issues.  The company has been acknowledged by the Drama League of New York and American Theatre magazine for being one of the top fifty regional theaters in the country.  PlayMakers operates under agreements with the Actors' Equity Association, United Scenic Artists, and the Society of Stage Directors and Choreographers.
